info.name: Red Hat OpenShift Cluster Manager API

params.name: page
params.description: The page number for paginated results. Page numbering starts at 1.

params.name: size
params.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

params.name: search
params.description: A search filter expression to narrow results. Supports field comparisons using operators such as =, <>, LIKE, IN.

params.name: order
params.description: The ordering criteria for results. Specify a field name followed by asc or desc for the sort direction.

items.docs: Retrieves a list of OpenShift clusters managed by the authenticated account. Results can be filtered by various criteria and paginated using the page and size parameters.

Provisions a new OpenShift cluster. The request body must include the cluster name, cloud provider, region, and desired node configuration. The cluster creation process is asynchronous and the cluster status will transition through several states before becoming ready.

params.name: cluster_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the cluster.

items.docs: Retrieves the details of a specific OpenShift cluster by its unique identifier, including its current status, configuration, and metadata.

items.docs: Updates the configuration of an existing OpenShift cluster. Only the fields provided in the request body will be modified. Some changes may trigger asynchronous operations such as node scaling.

items.docs: Initiates the deletion of an OpenShift cluster. The cluster will be deprovisioned asynchronously and all associated resources in the cloud provider will be cleaned up.

items.docs: Retrieves the list of machine pools configured for a specific cluster. Machine pools define groups of compute nodes with shared instance type and scaling configuration.

params.name: cluster_id

items.docs: Creates a new machine pool for a cluster, defining a group of compute nodes with specified instance type, replica count, and optional autoscaling configuration.

items.docs: Retrieves the list of identity providers configured for a specific cluster. Identity providers define how users authenticate to the OpenShift cluster.
